job.title: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d) bei CGM

tailoring.headline: Product Owner & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Expert | 5+ yrs Java, API & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and micro-service design. Proven techno-functional experience: requirement analysis, user-story creation, stakeholder workshops and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Agile team player, AI-assisted development, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and production support. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with a focus on business-driven e-commerce value.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by CGM’s vision to accelerate digital commerce for industrial clients. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical expertise with a proven ability to translate business needs into robust e-commerce solutions. I am eager to bring this blend of product ownership and hands-on development to your team.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Led requirement workshops, wrote user stories and functional specs, and guided cross-functional teams to deliver integrated PIM-ERP-MDM data flows on SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST services and built end-to-end data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) that synchronized product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: Agile Product Delivery
bullets.text: Worked in Scrum teams, prioritized backlogs, coordinated sprint planning and ensured continuous delivery through CI/CD pipelines on CCv2.

bullets.label: Business Impact Focus
bullets.text: Implemented API migrations and performance-tuned queries that reduced latency by 30 % and improved order-to-cash reliability for enterprise customers.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to CGM’s product roadmap.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die digitale Transformation im industriellen Handel begeistert mich – genau das treibt CGM an. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud Projekten bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verbinde ich tiefes technisches Know-how mit der Fähigkeit, Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen zu überführen. Gerne bringe ich diese Kombination aus Product-Owner-Verantwortung und Hands-On-Entwicklung in Ihr Team ein.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Leitung
bullets.text: Leitete Anforderungsworkshops, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und steuerte interdisziplinäre Teams zur Umsetzung integrierter PIM-ERP-MDM Datenflüsse in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: API- und Integrationskompetenz
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte OCC-REST-Services sowie End-to-End-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) zur Synchronisation globaler Produktkataloge.

bullets.label: Agile Produktlieferung
bullets.text: Arbeitete in Scrum-Teams, priorisierte Backlogs, koordinierte Sprint-Planungen und sicherte kontinuierliche Auslieferung über CI/CD-Pipelines auf CCv2.

bullets.label: Geschäftlicher Mehrwert
bullets.text: Realisiert API-Migrationen und performance-optimierte Queries, die die Latenz um 30 % senkten und die Order-to-Cash-Stabilität für Unternehmenskunden verbesserten.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zur Produktstrategie von CGM zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: CGM stands out as a leader in enabling industrial manufacturers to sell digitally at scale. Your commitment to open-source, cloud-native commerce platforms aligns perfectly with my experience modernising SAP Commerce Cloud landscapes. I am motivated by the chance to shape end-to-end digital buying journeys for your customers and to grow within a company that values innovation, sustainability and deep industry expertise.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to drive CGM’s digital commerce vision by applying my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and product-owner mindset to deliver high-impact, customer-centric solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of product-owner experience. I’m very interested in the Product Owner role at CGM and would love to discuss how I can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Product Owner SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud position. I bring over five years of hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, combined with strong business-analysis and stakeholder-management skills. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for CGM.

Best regards
